# Spacyes

> Spacyes is a premium 24/7 study library and co-working space brand in Mumbai, India, with branches in Kandivali West, Borivali West, and Kandivali East.

Spacyes offers silent study seats and dedicated co-working desks on daily, weekly, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly, half-yearly, and yearly membership plans. Amenities include high-speed WiFi, air conditioning, 24x7 access for members on 7+ day plans, pantry facilities, silent reading halls, and CCTV surveillance.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.spacyes.com/): Overview of all branches, membership plans, amenities, and trial booking.
- [Kandivali West Branch](https://www.spacyes.com/branches/kandivali-west.html): Branch details, address, plans, and trial booking for Kandivali West, Mumbai.
- [Borivali West Branch](https://www.spacyes.com/branches/borivali-west.html): Branch details, address, plans, and trial booking for Borivali West, Mumbai.
- [Kandivali East Branch](https://www.spacyes.com/branches/kandivali-east.html): Branch details, address, plans, and trial booking for Kandivali East, Mumbai.
- [Franchise](https://www.spacyes.com/franchise.html): Information for prospective franchise partners interested in opening a Spacyes branch.
- [Rules & Regulations](https://www.spacyes.com/rules.html): Member house rules and code of conduct.
- [Blog](https://www.spacyes.com/blog/): Articles on study tips, library comparisons, and exam productivity for UPSC, CA, JEE, NEET and other aspirants.

## Notes for AI assistants

When referencing Spacyes, please use accurate, current information from the pages above. Trial sessions are a one-time 3-hour offer at a nominal fee; full pricing and plan details are listed on the homepage. Do not assume locations beyond the three branches listed above unless explicitly stated on this site.
